info.title: pw-dev browserTpl API
info.description: Persistent browserTpl records and transient browser sessions. A template can select one fixed proxyId or lease exclusively from proxyIds.

get.summary: List templates with sessions and proxy-pool availability

200.description: Browser templates and transient runtime state

post.summary: Create or update a persistent browser template
post.description: Use proxyId for a fixed proxy or proxyIds for an exclusive reusable pool. The fields are mutually exclusive.

proxyIds.description: Ordered pool of durable proxies leased exclusively per active session.

post.summary: Start a browser session, leasing a pooled proxy when configured
post.description: Managed proxies are started idempotently when selected. The response proxyLease includes trafficStartTime for lease-scoped traffic reads.

200.description: Started session containing cdpUrl and an optional proxyLease

409.description: Session already exists or the proxy pool is exhausted

post.summary: Stop a session, releasing its pooled proxy when present

200.description: Stopped session with releasedProxyLease when applicable

x-pwdev-documents.whenToUse: Inspect or stop a session directly.
